name: plain
summary: For one person and their agent. No sprints, no stakeholders, no ceremony — intent, proof, and a loop that keeps you honest. The record speaks like a notebook that refuses to let you fool yourself.
law: Words change. The contract does not: paths, file names, statuses, command names, exit codes, and diagnostic codes are identical in every pack. The sixteen statutes are recorded verbatim and are never re-voiced.

01-document.gloss: intent sharpened until it is small, clear, and testable

02-compose.gloss: the thing itself, built and kept working

03-demonstrate.gloss: prove it works, then ship it

04-govern.gloss: the loop closed: watch, measure, learn, adjust

streams.01-document/01-discover: [Finding] an idea or irritation enters, before any list exists · producer: you, living with the problem → consumer: 02-refine
streams.01-document/02-refine: [Finding] make it small and clear — sharpen, size, order · producer: you → consumer: 04-plan
streams.01-document/03-validate: [Grounding] test the cheap assumptions before you commit — a spike, not a plan · producer: an hour of trying things → consumer: one clear item worth building
streams.01-document/04-plan: [Grounding] decide what you are building next — and what you are not · producer: you → consumer: 02-compose/01-build
streams.02-compose/01-build: [Rising] build it tests-first, so the proof exists the day you finish · producer: one clear item → consumer: 02-integrate
streams.02-compose/02-integrate: [Rising] keep it working — merged, green, re-read by you tomorrow · producer: 01-build → consumer: 01-demo
streams.02-compose/03-enhance: [Nurturing] the improvements you noticed while actually using it · producer: daily use → consumer: 01-build
streams.02-compose/04-maintain: [Nurturing] breakage and debt, fixed before they pile up · producer: breakage, your own notes → consumer: 01-build
streams.03-demonstrate/01-demo: [Nurturing] show it working — to yourself, honestly, end to end · producer: 02-integrate → consumer: 02-accept
streams.03-demonstrate/02-accept: [Nurturing] the acceptance criteria you wrote are the ones you met · producer: 01-demo → consumer: 03-release
streams.03-demonstrate/03-release: [Nurturing] cut the version you would defend · producer: 02-accept → consumer: 04-deploy
streams.03-demonstrate/04-deploy: [Nurturing] put it where you actually use it · producer: 03-release → consumer: 04-govern/01-monitor
streams.04-govern/01-monitor: [Nurturing] reality tells the truth · producer: 04-deploy → consumer: 02-measure
streams.04-govern/02-measure: [Leaving] did it do what you built it for — outcomes only, no self-scoring theatre · producer: 01-monitor → consumer: 03-retrospect
streams.04-govern/03-retrospect: [Leaving] what you learned, written down while it is fresh · producer: you → consumer: 04-improve
streams.04-govern/04-improve: [Leaving] the changes you decided on, each with a when · producer: 03-retrospect → consumer: the next idea — the loop closes

gateQuestions.GQ-1: What does this do, in one sentence your future self can verify?
gateQuestions.GQ-2: What proof will exist that each acceptance criterion actually ran?
gateQuestions.GQ-3: What is most likely to stop this from landing — and what will you do then?
gateQuestions.GQ-4: What are you deliberately not doing?

glossary.the list: 01-document/02-refine — where ideas are sharpened before anything is built
glossary.a spike: 01-document/03-validate — a time-boxed test of one assumption, thrown away after
glossary.tests-first: 02-compose/01-build — the proof is written while the code is
glossary.show it working: 03-demonstrate/01-demo — an honest end-to-end run, even with no audience
glossary.the criteria you wrote: 03-demonstrate/02-accept — acceptance is measured against your own spec, nothing else
glossary.where you actually use it: 03-demonstrate/04-deploy — your real machine or real users, not a folder called staging
glossary.the loop: 04-govern — watch, measure, learn, adjust; the reason the record exists
glossary.proof: proofs.md — paths that exist on disk and are checked at the deliver gate
glossary.the gate: docodego deliver — four checks; nothing is recorded as done until they pass
